inputs: Exact frozen R2 suite, prompts, original workspace inventories and matrix; freeze an updated runtime and the same run driver. Use existing selection-paraphrases-v4 assessor offline for all comparisons.
retry_policy: No retry in place, no model fallback. Preserve every started episode, including transport and wall failures. A second adaptive round, if needed, is declared separately before calls.
hypotheses: Expose current acceptance references and native command choices in the done schema to reduce malformed authored mappings, without filling reports or weakening completion gates.

Share a compact repair brief with human-declared source paths, native read bounds/freshness and latest successful edit; emphasize tracing assertions to existing source and preserving working behavior.
primary_outcome: Independent artifacts plus native baseline/fresh proof plus authored accepted report; strict all-file scope reported separately.
secondary_outcomes: Added dependencies or test-local bookkeeping in production
limitations: Adaptive development fixture, not held out
Joint schema and prompt intervention, not ablation
One episode per model per round; retained earlier baseline, not interleaved randomized control
No claims of semantic proof from schema choices; no automatic report generation
